title: 真实无人值守TTY选择：显式PTY承载确认，二进制批处理保持独立管道
body:
## 操作任务
实现execute(argv,interactive,payload)。interactive精确bool，payload为最多4096字节bytes；非交互只用独立stdin/stdout/stderr管道并保留原始字节与退出码，不能因命令拒绝就偷偷重试PTY。显式交互用自建PTY连接三个标准流，关闭输入回显，送入批准行并捕获合并终端输出，保留真实退出码；2秒期限和64KiB交互输出上限，超限RuntimeError，kill/wait仅自有进程并关闭master/slave。返回code/stdout/stderr，PTY模式stderr为空因流已合并。argv为夹具提供的可信参数列表、不用shell。平台真实TTY-only程序先在管道拒绝，再验证批准/拒绝流程；NUL/非UTF8/CRLF批数据不得经过终端转换或混入诊断。

## 提交产物
task.py

## 验收方法
python3 checks/check.py；实际隔离原生进程与明确边界。

## 能力边界
真实非root Linux PTY及内核isatty、行规程和子进程；不触碰宿主终端，不运行远程SSH。只满足明确检查标准流TTY的教学CLI，不承诺控制终端、作业控制、任意交互协议或生产命令安全；通用超时回收复用不另计。
review_note: 现有ID改编；完成情况按精确题目、执行bundle及原生五路证据核对，不以脚本生成认定完成。
rubric: 解释题设特有机制及前提
给出可核验的证据、成功与失败判据
界定异常恢复与不可承诺的边界

conversion.original_title: 把只能在终端正常工作的维护命令纳入无人值守流程，怎样评审PTY依赖而非盲目增加伪终端？

exercise.environment: 非root Linux，现有本地原生工具，自有短生命周期资源
exercise.operation: 实现execute(argv,interactive,payload)。interactive精确bool，payload为最多4096字节bytes；非交互只用独立stdin/stdout/stderr管道并保留原始字节与退出码，不能因命令拒绝就偷偷重试PTY。显式交互用自建PTY连接三个标准流，关闭输入回显，送入批准行并捕获合并终端输出，保留真实退出码；2秒期限和64KiB交互输出上限，超限RuntimeError，kill/wait仅自有进程并关闭master/slave。返回code/stdout/stderr，PTY模式stderr为空因流已合并。argv为夹具提供的可信参数列表、不用shell。平台真实TTY-only程序先在管道拒绝，再验证批准/拒绝流程；NUL/非UTF8/CRLF批数据不得经过终端转换或混入诊断。
exercise.validation_scope: 真实非root Linux PTY及内核isatty、行规程和子进程；不触碰宿主终端，不运行远程SSH。只满足明确检查标准流TTY的教学CLI，不承诺控制终端、作业控制、任意交互协议或生产命令安全；通用超时回收复用不另计。

test_files.checks/check.py:
import os,sys,pathlib,tempfile,subprocess,time,hashlib
sys.path.insert(0,os.getcwd());import task
assert sys.platform=='linux' and os.geteuid()!=0
print('NATIVE_LINUX_READY',flush=True)
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='of-pty-choice-') as directory:
 root=pathlib.Path(directory);interactive=root/'approval.py';binary=root/'batch.py'
 interactive.write_text("import sys,os\nif not all(os.isatty(fd) for fd in (0,1,2)):\n sys.stderr.write('TTY_REQUIRED\\n');sys.exit(23)\nsys.stdout.write('PROMPT> ');sys.stdout.flush()\nanswer=input()\nprint('APPROVED' if answer=='approve' else 'DENIED')\nsys.exit(0 if answer=='approve' else 7)\n")
 binary.write_text("import sys,os\nassert not any(os.isatty(fd) for fd in (0,1,2))\ndata=sys.stdin.buffer.read();sys.stdout.buffer.write(data);sys.stderr.buffer.write(b'DIAGNOSTIC\\n')\n")
 argv=[sys.executable,'-I',str(interactive)]
 initial=subprocess.run(argv,input=b'approve\n',capture_output=True,timeout=3);assert initial.returncode==23 and initial.stderr==b'TTY_REQUIRED\n'
 print('NATIVE_TTY_ONLY_APPROVAL_ACTUALLY_REFUSED_PIPE_INPUT',flush=True)
 print('STUDENT_OPERATION_ENTERED:explicit_pty_approval_separate_from_binary_batch_pipes',flush=True)
 before={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir()};fd_count=len(list(pathlib.Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir()));children=[];original_popen=subprocess.Popen
 def record(*args,**kwargs):
  child=original_popen(*args,**kwargs);children.append(child);return child
 subprocess.Popen=record
 try:
  try:
   for payload,code,output in [(b'approve\n',0,b'PROMPT> APPROVED\r\n'),(b'reject\n',7,b'PROMPT> DENIED\r\n')]:
    result=task.execute(argv,True,payload);assert result==dict(code=code,stdout=output,stderr=b''),'PTY not real, prompt lost, echo not disabled or status hidden'
   result=task.execute(argv,False,b'approve\n');assert result==dict(code=23,stdout=b'',stderr=b'TTY_REQUIRED\n'),'noninteractive request silently promoted to PTY'
   payload=b'one\nsecond\r\n\x00binary\xffend'
   result=task.execute([sys.executable,'-I',str(binary)],False,payload)
   assert result==dict(code=0,stdout=payload,stderr=b'DIAGNOSTIC\n'),'batch data transformed by terminal or diagnostic stream merged'
  except Exception as error:raise AssertionError('student explicit terminal-mode execution failed') from error
  sleeper=root/'sleeper.py';sleeper.write_text('import time;time.sleep(30)')
  started=time.monotonic()
  try:task.execute([sys.executable,'-I',str(sleeper)],True,b'')
  except RuntimeError:pass
  else:raise AssertionError('interactive timeout left unbounded wait')
  assert time.monotonic()-started<3.5
  assert all(child.returncode is not None for child in children),'owned child not reaped'
  for child in children:
   try:os.kill(child.pid,0)
   except ProcessLookupError:pass
   else:raise AssertionError('owned child remains alive or zombie')
  assert len(list(pathlib.Path('/proc/self/fd').iterdir()))==fd_count,'PTY master/slave or pipe FD leaked'
 finally:
  subprocess.Popen=original_popen
  for child in children:
   if child.poll() is None:child.kill()
   child.wait()
 assert before=={p.name:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in root.iterdir() if p.name!='sleeper.py'}
 print('NATIVE_EXPLICIT_PTY_APPROVAL_BINARY_PIPES_DIAGNOSTIC_SEPARATION_AND_TIMEOUT_REAP',flush=True)
print('NATIVE_SEMANTIC_ASSERTIONS_PASSED',flush=True)
